title: AEGS Compliance Assessment
description:
Which control obligations an implementation asserts it exercised for one action, expressed against a named **profile** rather than a regulation.

AEGS never asserts that an action is compliant with any law. It records that specified controls ran and what they found. Whether that satisfies an obligation is a legal determination requiring a qualified person, a jurisdiction, and facts a technical layer does not hold. See AEGS-CROSSWALK-001.

profile.description: The control profile applied, e.g. 'aegs-baseline', 'fatf-aligned'. A profile is a selection of AEGS controls, NOT a claim of regulatory conformity.

state.description: `not-implemented` is an honest answer and must not be reported as `not-applicable`.

evidence.description: Pointer to the EvidenceRecord that substantiates this.

assertedBy.description: Who makes this assertion. Self-assertion is the default and must be visible as such.

externallyReviewed.description: False or null means nobody outside the implementer has checked it.
